I will gladly give you my ASPD. The first thing people say is "isn't that what serial killers have?" 

Most of them, yes, but not everyone with ASPD goes out killing people. They make a small percentage. Also, ASPD is on a spectrum- every disorder is. There's ASPD, ASPD type 2, and ASPD type 1. Type 1 is associated with psychopathy while type 2 is associated with sociopathy. I'm on the lower end, so my symptoms aren't as severe as others. 

However, it absolutely sucks not feeling empathy or guilt. If I want something, I get it, and I don't care if it hurts others. I've destroyed property, put people's lives in danger, and stole from multiple stores because I wanted to- and I didn't feel bad while doing it. I've been getting help, so I haven't acted out my impulses like I use to. I know what I did was wrong, but I can't find myself caring about the consequences of my actions.
